title: Extended thinking interleaved with a tool loop

turns.prompt: Read every .txt file in the current directory, then reason out which of them could have been generated by the same rule and justify the grouping.
Re-check your grouping against the file you read last and say whether it still holds.

notes: Thinking plus tools is a distinct shape from either alone: the resent assistant turn carries a thinking block next to a tool_use block. LIMIT, measured 2026-08-30: the wire-pattern claim selects the FIRST request that satisfies it, and this case's `thinking` claim is already satisfied by turn 1 on the top-level thinking config alone -- so the fixture that lands carries NO thinking or tool_use block, and the interleaved shape this case describes lives in the later candidates the rig counts redundant. A case whose distinguishing shape appears only after turn 1 needs a narrower claim (a body census) if the fixture must exhibit it. See bl-case-claim-vs-pinned-fixture-shape-gap.
